title: automation.input
description: One agent input, published by a driver (browser host CDP/WebKit drivers, CUA host) before it dispatches the input. The cmux app draws the agent cursor from these events (plans/cmux-next/agent-cursor.md section 2). Coordinates are never screen points.

target_id.description: Browser tab id, or cua:<pid>:<window_id> for a desktop window.

space.description: viewport: CSS px of the top-level document viewport (after scroll, iframe offsets resolved). window: window-local points of the desktop target window.

point.description: Where the input lands. Required for move, click, double_click, right_click, drag (start) and scroll (wheel position).

rect.description: Target element rect in the same space, when known.

to.description: drag: end point. scroll: wheel delta {x, y}.
